lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Master! Are you busy?
No, I'm free.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Thank goodness.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Those notes you mentioned...
Yeah, sorry. Those were Drake's doing.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Oh, so she wrote those?

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: I went to look for them after you left,

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: but I didn't have enough time before Ade and Cocoa got back

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: and we had to reopen, so I wasn't able to check.
Uh oh...

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Anyway, a customer found one

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: and asked who wrote it.
And then?

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: On it was written:

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Something which will forever haunt you is likely to occur.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Needless to say, I figured that was one of the notes that you mentioned.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: I apologized profusely and tried to take it back, but

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: the customer said it just so happened she'd been ruminating over an important decision she had to make,

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: and that she was happy the note had helped her reach a decision.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: She even asked if we'd had a fortune teller come into the cafe, haha!

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: She ended up leaving feeling quite at peace.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Afterwards, lots of people found the other notes,

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: and they all left super happy!

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: There was someone who was deliberating over whether to retake an exam that she'd kept failing,

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: but then she found a note telling her to give up, and so she did.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Another customer was considering starting a business with a friend, but

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: after seeing the note talking about how she'll be betrayed by someone close to her, she decided not to go through with it.
Hmm...

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Anyway, I just wanted to let you know nothing major happened.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: In case you were worrying about it, hehe.
Thank you. I'm relieved to hear that.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Sure thing!

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: You and Miss Drake are welcome to come back to the Maid Cafe anytime.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: I'll make some delicious desserts for you both the next time you come, hehe.
Thank you.
